definition: Dashboard Design Principles is a core concept in Data Analytics. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Dashboard Design Principles is
theory.body: Dashboard Design Principles describes the methods and patterns used within Data Analytics to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Dashboard Design Principles is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Dashboard Design Principles matters
theory.body: Without Dashboard Design Principles, systems built with Data Analytics are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Dashboard Design Principles works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Dashboard Design Principles follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Dashboard Design Principles.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Dashboard Design Principles
theory.body: Dashboard Design Principles offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
